title: Systematic Bias in Large Language Models: Discrepant Response Patterns in Binary vs. Continuous Judgment Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the proportion of negative or oppositional judgments made by LLMs when prompted with binary response formats (e.g., Yes/No) versus continuous response scales (e.g., 0-10 or 1-6 Likert scales) across value judgment and sentiment analysis tasks.
